definitions.explanation: Used to describe attractive, well-formed handwriting, and also as a category for handwriting improvement courses and books.

examples.japanese: {美文字|びもじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}ける→書く：00477_kaku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be able to write beautiful handwriting.

examples.japanese: {美文字|びもじ}⟦レッスン→レッスン：01542_ressun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started attending beautiful handwriting lessons.

examples.japanese: {美文字|びもじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{方|かた}→持ち方：28218_mochikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: For practicing beautiful handwriting, proper posture and pen grip are important.

notes:
Combines ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧ (beauty) and ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧ (characters/writing). A popular term in Japanese culture where handwriting quality is highly valued. There is a thriving industry of {美文字|びもじ} books, courses, and TV segments teaching how to write more elegantly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美文字|びもじ}⟦レッスン→レッスン：01542_ressun⟧: beautiful handwriting lessons
- {美文字|びもじ}{練習帳|れんしゅうちょう}: penmanship practice workbook
- {美文字|びもじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧: tips for beautiful handwriting
- {美文字|びもじ}⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧: beautiful handwriting course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{達筆|たっぴつ}→達筆：26860_tappitsu⟧: excellent calligraphy/penmanship — more traditional, implies mastery
- ⟦{悪筆|あくひつ}→悪筆：27028_akuhitsu⟧: bad handwriting — the opposite
- ⟦{癖字|くせじ}→癖字：28674_kuseji⟧: idiosyncratic handwriting — not necessarily bad, but distinctive
